body.name: Fixed one-alias-block legal-lift stratification handle
body.construction:
Restrict to \(\mathcal S^{+}_{2+1}\) and fix \((g,r)=(0,1)\). Form, from rational fixed-chart stopped-law coordinates, the similarity-invariant projector onto the emission-distinct state and its complementary two-state alias block. On the alias block retain the full row-stochastic centralizer
\[
 S(a,b)=\begin{pmatrix}a&1-a\\ b&1-b\end{pmatrix},\qquad a\ne b,
\]
embedded by the identity on the emission-distinct state. Express the transformed initial row, the transformed hazard
\[
 S(a,b)\operatorname{diag}\{S(a,b)^{-1}h_{12}\}S(a,b)^{-1},
\]
where \(h_{12}=(h_1,h_2)^{\top}\), the killed dynamics, and the de-killed transition as bivariate rational functions of \((a,b)\). Define the positive legal region by all normalization, nonvanishing-denominator, and strict positivity inequalities required by \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{legal}}\). Clear only denominators certified nonzero on each positive legal component. Test constancy of every coordinate of \(\pi^0_{0,1}\) by bivariate rational numerator identities on that component. Separate the HDK branch from every forecast-degenerate branch on which HDK fails but the target is constant. A reduction to univariate sign problems is permitted only after a proved elimination or parameterization; connectedness is not imported from an ordinary aliased-HMM model. Use subresultant chains and Sturm--Habicht sign determination when such a reduction has been proved, record every polynomial or rational invariant and its degree, and enumerate every positive legal-fiber component. The computation exploits the fixed one-block dimension rather than invoking generic cylindrical algebraic decomposition.
inputs: rational coordinates of \(P_W\in\mathcal S^{+}_{2+1}\) in the predeclared chart
